pairs.registryProposal: The claim-write-back technique forbids naked booleans without timestamps, run identifiers, or rung provenance. However, lightweight human-facing repository manifests like ai-manifest.yaml prioritize clean, low-churn single-line flow mappings for ease of manual review. The standard could provide guidance on sibling ledger files or split metadata profiles for cases where in-band stamp serialization adds prohibitive diff churn.
